When you arrive there is Chaos all around. Siege machines, both aerial and water based are laying waste to droves of soldiers on either side. There is some scattered fighting near you (on the eastern edge of the map) but no one has yet taken an interest in you. The Fishmother and longshadow are wading through the fray slowly making their way toward one another. Fireballs and lightning bolts are ripping through the battle field windwalls and water walls are making what amounts to be trench warfare for the ground troops. The Lake itself is beginning to change color, being polluted with free running blood.
Web looks at the presence of the two leaders, remembering the warning in their letter. They shudder and lead onward.

For the purpose of the trip,
```• Difficult terrain doesn’t slow your group’s travel.
• Your group can’t become lost except by magical means.
• Even when you are engaged in another activity while traveling (such as foraging, navigating, or tracking), you remain alert to danger.```
